Verses.Text: Fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge; wisdom and instruction fools despise.
Trust in the LORD with all your heart, on your own intelligence do not rely.
In all your ways be mindful of him, and he will make straight your paths.
With all vigilance guard your heart, for in it are the sources of life.
The beginning of wisdom is fear of the LORD, and knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.
Who can find a woman of worth? Far beyond jewels is her value.
Charm is deceptive and beauty fleeting; the woman who fears the LORD is to be praised.
